snippet.title: Warm Snow - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the Warm Snow trailer for a look at some Warm Snow gameplay and more from the action-roguelite game set in a dark fantasy world. Warm Snow is available now on PC.

In Warm Snow, take on the role of the warrior 'Bi-an' on a quest to save a world teetering on the brink of destruction. The game is based upon the history, mythology, and folklore of Eastern cultures. The game's upcoming DLC will bring more tools including new relics, Excaliburs, and a powerful NPC known as the Soul Blacksmith.
